text:
elaine: Heads up — Ottawa region launch: CloudVendor + SiliconCo are greenlit. We need a compact launch playbook covering marketplace SKU entitlements, quota requests, KMS/HSM approvals, SI integration creds, and a joint announcement window. Who can take which pieces?

marco: I can own partner comms and the marketplace flow. Need committed capacity numbers from infra so I can request SKU entitlements from CloudVendor.

jia: From infra POV: recommend initial dedicated pool: min 4 GPUs, target 16 GPUs, burst to 32 for promos. For planning, we should request 32 A100-equivalent GPUs and 200 vCPUs in the quota ticket. Also want to enable prefix/KV cache on the pool.

sam: I filed the quota request with CloudVendor: QT-10982 (status: open). ETA 72 business hours per them. Link: https://partner.cloud/vendor/quotas/QT-10982

deploy-bot: ticket QT-10982 created by sam — status: open — assignee: cloud-quotas@redwood

marco: KMS/HSM — SiliconCo requires that customer-managed keys be present for marketplace images before listing. @katie will need the co-marketing wording + approval for any joint PR. Also NimbleSI needs API creds for the integration testing.

katie: I can review the co-marketing draft and the legal checklist tomorrow morning. Please drop the draft text and any partner logos in the shared drive. Note: need partner logo usage agreement before PR.

elaine: Draft playbook (early): https://redwood.internal/playbooks/ottawa-region-launch (working doc). Key checklist snippet below:

```
- Quota request QT-10982 submitted
- KMS/HSM: request key export policy & HSM certs from SiliconCo
- Marketplace entitlements requested by partner ops
- SI integration creds provisioned and smoke tests run
- Legal sign-off on co-marketing + logos
- Announce window: T+10 business days after quotas approved
```

jia: Ops config notes: set autoscale min=4 max=32, scale step=4, kv_cache=true. Quick command to check region quotas locally: 

```
gcloud compute regions describe northamerica-northeast1 --format=json | jq '.quotas'
```

sam: If QT-10982 isn't approved within 48h I'll escalate to the CloudVendor partner manager. I'll also attach the usage profile and throughput projections to the ticket (peak tokens/min, concurrency targets).

elaine: Owners: sam (quotas & escalation), jia (infra config & caching), marco (partner comms & marketplace entitlements), katie (legal & PR). I'll own overall program and timeline. I'll follow up with a short status update EOD. :thumbsup:

marco: Thanks — I'll ping CloudVendor PM and SiliconCo onboarding lead for the KMS artifacts.

katie: Received — will confirm logo usage and draft blurb by EOD tomorrow.

elaine: Great — thanks everyone. Will post an updated timeline once QT-10982 moves to approved.
